An admission auction is a sale of 100 identity slots per epoch. The clearing price sets entry cost. A karst registry maps bids to credentials.

Bids lock for 3 epochs. A raven audit stamps each bid to block reuse. A 2-epoch challenge burns forged bids. Losers are refunded minus 2%.

Cost math: at 60 units, 1,000 clones cost 60,000. The beacon feed shows demand doubling doubles price. 10,000 clones cost 1,000,000+. Forgery bids against itself.
